item.title: Australian man arrested in Thailand over teenage girl's murder
item.description:
A 46-year-old Australian man has been arrested at a Thai airport in connection with the alleged murder of a 17-year-old girl. The victim's body was discovered in a suitcase. The suspect was detained while attempting to board a flight to Perth.
